column1: # Causes of the yaegi v2 failures of cmd/stdtests (tests that pass natively and
# not in a yaegi v2 mode). Columns: package, test, class, causes (short names, or -).
#   wrong  - silent wrong result: the test fails on a value
#   crash  - the test ends with a panic of yaegi v2 or a fatal error ("unsupported", stop)
#   panic  - a panic with another message or value than in Go
#   allocs - the test counts allocations (testing.AllocsPerRun): the
#            interpreter allocates; not a wrong result
#   frames - the test counts the frames of runtime.Callers through native
#            code, which yaegi v2 does not show (docs/ARCHITECTURE.md)
#   slow   - the test does not end before the timeout of the runner
# cmd/stdtests writes "class issues" at the start of the reason column. A
# yaegi v2 failure without a line here is written "new".
